theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_pfi_integer_density_of_summable
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → Euclid P → ℤ), (∀ j, Measurable (f j)) → ∑' j, ∫⁻ y, ((f j y).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μHE[n] ≠ ∞ → ∃ m : Euclid P → ℝ, Measurable m ∧ (∀ y, ∃ z : ℤ, m y = z) ∧ (∀ y, ENNReal.ofReal |m y| ≤ ∑' j, ((f j y).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞)) ∧ ∀ᵐ y ∂μHE[n], Summable (fun j => (f j y : ℝ)) ∧ m y = ∑' j, (f j y : ℝ)
